name: Kalonian Wilds
description: A dense forest region of Shandalar full of feral beasts, where the sliver hive lies.

timeline.summary: Outside the city, Yisan reads the stolen book, the journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, revealing a sliver hive with abandoned treasure; Jalira decides to go.
timeline.quote: But contained within the notes were reports of dead merchants and travelers in the deepest parts of the sliver network

timeline.summary: Yisan and Jalira journey through the Kalonian Forest, fending off corrupted beasts and avoiding Talrand's aerial patrols.
timeline.quote: Neither counted the drake summoner as a friend for a variety of differing reasons

timeline.summary: They find the sliver cave and Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on them.
timeline.quote: Blue smoke began to flow from Jalira's fingertips.

timeline.summary: Jalira and Yisan, transformed into slivers, fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum and will of the hivelord.
timeline.quote: They lose each other, forgetting who they are.

timeline.summary: They reach the central chamber where the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and, naked, take clothing and treasure while the hivelord does nothing.
timeline.quote: slowly procured as many coins and treasures as they and their pilfered clothes could carry

timeline.summary: Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
timeline.quote: I think I'm going to stay here for a while,

pages_say.description: A dense forest region of Shandalar full of feral beasts, where the sliver hive lies.
